$comment: Frontmatter-only edits that a vendored file needs to load or be invoked in Claude Code. Same shape as model-map.json.

rules.from: Read the `poteto-mode` skill's `SKILL.md` in full before doing any work, including its inline Principles index.
rules.to: The `faker-mode` skill is `disable-model-invocation`, so the Skill tool refuses it. Your first action is to run `/faker-mode` as a user-style command, then read the `faker-mode` skill's `SKILL.md` in full before doing any work, including its inline Principles index.

rules.from: search `~/.cursor/plugins/` for a file whose path ends in `skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md`. If more than one file matches, use the copy whose `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` has the highest `version`.
rules.to: search `~/.claude/plugins/` for a file whose path ends in `skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md`. If more than one file matches, use the copy whose `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` has the highest `version`.
